narrative.details: Return to my mate, Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village. Tell her that I am coming home! She is sure to reward you.
narrative.objectives: Elder Torntusk at Jintha'alor wants you to return to Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village with news of his rescue.
narrative.offerRewardText: You have done the Revantusk a great service, adventurer! We owe you a great debt of gratitude.

chain.subtitle: 3 quests at level 51, 15,900 XP in all.

quests.name: Kidnapped Elder Torntusk!
quests.objectiveText: Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to rescue her mate, Elder Torntusk, from Jintha'alor. You have been told that he is being held prisoner atop Ji

quests.name: Recover the Key!
quests.objectiveText: Elder Torntusk at Jintha'alor wants you to kill Hitah'ya the Keeper to get the Shackle Key to his bindings.

quests.name: Return to Primal Torntusk
quests.objectiveText: Elder Torntusk at Jintha'alor wants you to return to Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village with news of his rescue.
